about.form.title: About {0}
about.heading: Windows & Office Configuration and License Assurance Tool
about.product.title: PRODUCT
about.purpose.title: INTENDED USE
about.purpose.body: A local administration suite with 10 functions for configuration inventory, Windows/Office assessment, software and tampering review, confirmed backup/remediation, valid-license management, advanced investigation, and verifiable reporting.
about.model.title: OPERATING MODEL
about.model.body: One local application provides 10 functions through a single EXE. Inspection is read-only by default; system changes require Administrator rights, preview, explicit selection, confirmation, and backup. The tool starts Offline, and only Function 8 uses LAN after the user explicitly switches it Online. No mandatory cloud service, telemetry, or automatic report upload is used.
about.technology.title: TECHNOLOGY & LANGUAGES
about.technology.body: A C#/.NET Framework 4 launcher packages the AnyCPU EXE, verifies SHA-256, and selects the native architecture. The interface and workflows use Windows PowerShell/WinForms; catalogs and data contracts use JSON; reports use HTML/CSS, JSON, and XML; protected local data uses DPAPI/HMAC. PDFs are generated locally with Edge, Chrome, or Word, never through an online conversion service.
about.support.title: SUPPORT
about.release.title: DOWNLOAD & VERIFY THE OFFICIAL RELEASE
about.terms.title: COPYRIGHT & TERMS
about.terms.body: © 2026 Thanh Viet. Source is published for responsible review, research, and development. Do not remove attribution, impersonate the author, repackage, or redistribute it under another name without written permission.
about.safety.title: SAFETY & PRIVACY
about.safety.body: Inspection functions are read-only. System-changing functions require Administrator rights, preview, explicit selection, confirmation, and backup. Results are technical evidence for administration and do not replace invoices, contracts, or Microsoft entitlement records.

about.card.config.title: CONFIGURATION & LICENSING
about.card.config.body: Use functions 01–05 for full, hardware, Windows, Office, and software inventory; use function 07 to inspect the firmware OEM key.
about.card.remediation.title: DETECTION & REMEDIATION
about.card.remediation.body: Use function 06 for reviewed KMS/activator remediation with backup and post-checks; use function 08 to manage valid licenses.
about.card.report.title: VERIFIABLE REPORTS
about.card.report.body: Functions 01–05, 09, and 10 export HTML/PDF, integration JSON/XML, SHA-256 manifests, and before/after evidence.
about.card.assurance.title: ASSURANCE & EXTENSIBILITY
about.card.assurance.body: Use function 09 for deep/forensic inspection; function 10 opens certificates, plugins, the protected timeline, and the HTML guide.
about.note: One AnyCPU EXE · Windows 7 SP1–11 · local data processing · conclusions are technical evidence, not a substitute for legal records.
